prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs make the same change to buildWellKnownPath (replacing the single-slash .slice() strip with a multi-slash strip), so they will merge-conflict on identical lines. #2215 additionally fixes a follow-on bug in shouldAttemptFallback: after stripping trailing slashes, a root path normalizes to '' rather than '/', so the existing 'pathname === "/"' root check silently stops matching and triggers a redundant fallback request. #2215 introduces a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper used by both buildWellKnownPath and the corrected shouldAttemptFallback('' check), fixing the double-slash issue and its downstream fallback consequence in one place, whereas #2214 only patches the double-slash symptom and leaves the root-check inconsistency unaddressed.
